theme.description: Primary light theme for high-density data readability (Swiss & High Contrast), with selective dark mode components for emphasis (e.g., sidebars or modal takeovers).

headings.usage: Authoritative, clean headers for the dashboard, risk metrics, and auth screens. Strict tracking (tracking-tight).

body.usage: Legible, technical sans for long-form text, UI labels, and standard tabular data.

mono.usage: Used strictly for risk scores, NIB/NPWP IDs, wallet addresses, financial figures, and timestamps.

brand.accent_description: Royal blue for primary CTAs, progress steps, and active states.

rules: Never use pure transparent backgrounds over content.
Ensure all text passes WCAG AA contrast (APCA preferred) over surfaces.

layouts.strategy: Grid Borders (Technical/Compliance Look) & High Density Data
layouts.spacing: Dense internally (p-4 to p-6) but generous between major sections (gap-6 to gap-8).
layouts.dashboard_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 or 12-col bento grid. Tight gaps (gap-4).
layouts.borders: 1px solid border-gray-200. No shadows for cards, rely on borders. Max radius 4px (rounded-sm or rounded-md).
layouts.alignment: Strict left-alignment for all tabular and dense data. Center-align only empty states or distinct CTAs.

surfaces_and_components.strategy: Grid Borders & Solid Surfaces (No Glassmorphism for Data)
surfaces_and_components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow. Hover state: slightly darker border, DO NOT lift.
surfaces_and_components.tables: Table-first review queues. Consistent rows, clear sorting.
surfaces_and_components.forms: Pure Shadcn inputs, override rounded-md to rounded-sm. Explicit focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600).
surfaces_and_components.headers: Solid background with a hard bottom border (border-b).
surfaces_and_components.buttons: Sharp corners or max 4px radius. High contrast (Black or Royal Blue).
surfaces_and_components.status_badges: Minimal padding, stark borders, exact risk color text.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all rows and buttons. Subtle border color shifts. Micro-interactions for expanding rows/details.
motion.transitions: Specific properties only (e.g., transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform). No 'transition-all'.

icons_and_media.icon_usage: Dense dashboards and developer/fintech tools require Phosphor Icons for precision.

images.description: Abstract blue lines and dots on black background. Use as a dark thematic overlay for the Auth/Login screen side panel (opacity adjusted).
Jakarta skyline. Use subtle greyscale or low opacity for onboarding welcome screen to contextualize 'Crypto Exchange in Indonesia'.

icons_and_media.charts: Recharts or Shadcn charts. Use sharp rectangles for bars, no rounded corners. Dotted grid lines. Use Risk Indicator colors.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop' by strictly using the specified fonts (Manrope + IBM Plex Sans/Mono) and sharp, technical borders.
Do NOT apply universal transition 'transition: all'.
Do NOT center align the app container. Strict left-alignment for functional RegTech UI.
Data-dense tables must have explicit hover states (e.g., hover:bg-gray-50).
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='approve-kyb-button').
Use pure Shadcn components customized with 0-4px border radius for a professional, banking-grade aesthetic.
Never use generic placeholders for risk scores; use exact numeric structures (e.g., 84/100) using IBM Plex Mono.
Implement Sonner for toast notifications on approvals/rejections.

accessibility.focus: Clear focus indicators with high contrast (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-black or brand accent).
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY on all buttons, links, inputs, and tab triggers.
